description: A one-call brief on an airport's car hire market this morning. Per car type: the typical daily rate, the cheapest and dearest pick-up days in the next 14 and the gap between them, and weekend against weekday. Plus the number of brands, the best-rated and lowest-priced brands, and events and holidays in the window. Useful for a marketing brief, a morning operations check or a pricing meeting.

airport.description: IATA airport code, e.g. AKL, SYD, LHR, MAD. See list_airports.
